annotations.text:
The recording block on Call detail says "unavailable" on purpose.

Verified on the SM-M356B: Android 16 blocks third-party call recording even with RECORD_AUDIO granted. A play button here would be a lie, so the screen states the limit and keeps the call record complete.

Call history deliberately shows the awkward rows: an unknown number, a withheld (private) number, and a failed upload.

These are the cases that break naive designs, so they are drawn before the happy path is built.
Every value is lifted from the Mynt system already shipping in zebu_helpdesk — Inter, #0037B7, 12px cards, 8px inputs, 50px buttons, flat surfaces with 1px outlines. Nothing here invents a new token.
